translate_en|mods/FamilyZAdvancedMedicin: Scales effective antibiotic coverage after susceptibility, exposure and pathogen resistance are considered. Higher values improve treatment. Applies only in Custom.
Scales the rate at which antibiotic exposure and misuse increase pathogen resistance. Higher values accelerate resistance. Applies only in Custom.

Enables the Advanced Medicine blood-volume, red-cell mass, blood typing, crossmatch and transfusion model. When disabled, its physiological projections are neutralized without deleting stored blood history. Only applies in Custom.
Scales infectious dose generated by respiratory and wound exposure. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Scales environmental and use-related contamination gained by reusable medical equipment. Applies only in Custom.

Enables Advanced Medicine critical-care episode tracking and ABCDE/triage escalation. When disabled, active critical-care episodes are safely closed as disabled and no new episodes are generated. Only applies in Custom.

Scales how quickly active critical-care syndromes deteriorate and converge toward worsening evidence. Higher values increase escalation pressure. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Critical Care is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Scales how quickly active critical-care syndromes improve when the underlying evidence and treatment support recovery. Higher values improve recovery. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Critical Care is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Scales the time required for wound cultures to become available. Higher values make laboratory results take longer. Applies only in Custom.

Scales how quickly repeated exposure builds physical dependence when Drug Dependence is enabled. Applies only in Custom. Has no effect while Drug Dependence is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Scales diagnostic-reasoning uncertainty. Higher values make conclusions less certain. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Scales the probability that a valid exposure establishes disease. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Scales initial disease severity and untreated worsening. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Enables or disables tolerance-driven physical dependence and withdrawal for drugs with adaptation profiles. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Scales how quickly Advanced Medicine loot and crafted pharmaceutical batches reach expiration. Higher values shorten shelf life. It does not alter active drug effect duration. Applies only in Custom.

Scales blood-volume and red-cell loss produced by Advanced Medicine wound bleeding. Higher values cause faster blood loss. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Blood Management is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Scales effective host resistance used by disease transmission. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.

Selects the global medical experience. Arcade is forgiving; Balanced is the recommended baseline; Realistic increases clinical pressure; Extreme is intentionally punishing. When Custom is selected, the qualified controls below override the Balanced baseline. Difficulty profiles do not change privacy, telemetry, or bridge policy.
Scales therapeutic drug efficacy after patient-specific response and adaptation. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.

Scales disease-defined lethality pressure when an active disease becomes severe. It constrains general condition rather than using an independent instant-death roll. Higher values are more dangerous. Applies only in Custom.

Scales natural recovery of intravascular volume and red-cell mass when major active bleeding is absent. Higher values accelerate recovery. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Blood Management is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Scales the effective potency of prepared natural medicines. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.

Scales neurologic deterioration pressure used by the seizure-risk progression model. Higher values make neurologic crises more likely to progress. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Neurology is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Scales neurologic recovery, including the duration of postictal recovery after seizures. Higher values shorten recovery time. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Neurology is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Enables Advanced Medicine neurologic assessment, seizure-risk modelling and neurologic support. Disabling it clears active neurologic physiology/support while preserving historical records. Only applies in Custom.
Scales nutritional losses and the metabolic burden of activity and illness. Higher values are harsher. Applies only in Custom.
Scales toxicity burden against drug safety thresholds. Higher values make overdose states easier to reach. Applies only in Custom.

Scales the oxygenation benefit produced by active oxygen-support modalities. Higher values improve oxygen support. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Respiratory Support is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Scales success and complication pressure for basic and advanced medical procedures. Higher values are harder. Applies only in Custom.
Scales the effective time used by disease progression. Higher values make stages and untreated deterioration advance faster. Applies only in Custom.

Scales how long newly applied respiratory-support modalities remain active before expiring. Higher values extend support duration. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Respiratory Support is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Enables oxygen, ventilation and bronchodilator support effects. Disabling it safely ends active support interfaces, removes their projections and withdraws bronchodilator symptom suppression. Only applies in Custom.

Scales the probability that sufficient neurologic risk develops into an actual seizure episode. Higher values increase seizure risk. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Neurology is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Scales infection spread toward sepsis and its contribution to critical-care deterioration. Higher values are more dangerous. Applies only in Custom.
Scales patient sensitivity used when resolving medication adverse reactions. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Scales the penalty and contamination consequences caused by poor procedural sterility. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.
Scales Advanced Medicine medical-loot abundance. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.

Scales delta-based clinical evolution such as disease, wounds, infection, blood, respiratory, neurologic and critical-care progression. It does not accelerate pharmacokinetic clocks, item expiration or server/persistence timers. Applies only in Custom.

Scales how quickly repeated drug exposure builds tolerance. Higher values reduce efficacy sooner through adaptation. Applies only in Custom. Has no effect while Drug Dependence is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Scales the probability of transfusion reactions after compatibility, crossmatch and procedure factors are considered. Higher values increase risk. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Advanced Blood Management is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
Scales vaccine efficacy and inversely scales vaccine-failure pressure. Applies only when Medical Experience Profile is Custom.

Scales ventilation, CO2 clearance and assisted respiratory-rate effects from active ventilation support. Higher values improve support. Only applies in Custom. Has no effect while Respiratory Support is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.

Scales the intensity of withdrawal once dependence and abstinence meet the drug-specific thresholds. Applies only in Custom. Has no effect while Drug Dependence is disabled. The configured value is preserved while inactive.
